info.title: Semantic Router Apiserver
info.description: Router management API for configuration, plugin operations, prepared-model diagnostics, storage, and observability

tags.name: system
tags.description: Health, readiness, and API contract discovery.

tags.name: routing
tags.description: Preview routing behavior without generating an answer.

tags.name: diagnostics
tags.description: Inspect and invoke recipe-scoped prepared models, classifiers, embeddings, NLI, and rerankers.

tags.name: inventory
tags.description: Inspect configured and loaded model and classifier resources.

tags.name: observability
tags.description: Inspect routing replays, metrics, and management audit; submit outcome evidence.

tags.name: storage
tags.description: Manage Router-owned knowledge bases, memories, files, vector stores, cache partitions, and context recovery.

tags.name: plugins
tags.description: Discover recipe-scoped plugin bindings, dependencies, and typed behavior previews.

tags.name: config
tags.description: Validate, inspect, apply, version, and roll back Router configuration and Recipes.
